subject: tf-sh
title: TF.SH.-----POL.DY.
description: Diagram closing MP(I)-5 — the section examining sixties dynamic-activism's relationship to vibrational state and political-activism. The prose immediately above identifies the structural target: 'the composite thrust of sixties functionalism supplied the first response to the vibrational dictates of this transition cycle — and the nature of that response was never one-dimensional.' The crossing diagrams how transfer-shifts structurally meets political-dynamics at the sixties-activism scale: (R)TF-SH (the reality of transfer shifts) crossed with POL-DY (political dynamics — the political-working partner-axis). TF-SH sits on the left with the subject-arrow; SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) rises from the main line, ATTC (attachment) branches from SPT-DY, and F (form) branches from ATTC. POL-DY sits at the upper end of the main line as the partner. A second line runs from the main line to ALT-F (alternative functionalism) at the right margin; T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) rises from ALT-F's line, TR-INFO (trans-information) branches from T-C-IMP, and VT-IMP (vibrational implications) hangs from TR-INFO. MT-INFO (multi-information) descends from ALT-F's line, and AF-NT (affinity nature) and SOC-RT-INTR (social reality interpretation) branch from MT-INFO along the bottom.
